description: Elections Commission - Declare that a member of the Godakawela Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member
reasoning: This gazette notice declares a vacancy in a local authority (Godakawela Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls under electoral processes as it specifically references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and concerns the status of an elected member, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
